issues: A pale grey stage with a grey placeholder dashboard; the opening perspective strip was just a grey line with no suspense and no light
The page ended exactly full-frame, so there was no stage or space and the last frame was a flat screenshot
69 truly static frames after the 76f move: over two seconds of dead air
Only the page rotated while the background stayed put, so it never read as the camera tilting up
changes: Midnight look (deep navy, electric blue): the opening is a glowing 'horizon' in the dark, a bright line on the far edge of the flat page plus a wide blue bloom, visible from frame 1

A purpose-built subject: the dark analytics page 'Meridian' with a 120px headline 'Revenue is up 38%', a full-width glowing area chart and three 76px KPI figures; it lands at 0.84× with the stage light and a blue floor glow around it

The page now hinges on its bottom edge and lies face up (rotateX 86°) with the eye above it, so the type in the strip reads the right way up; a 40f asymmetric in-out lift overshoots to −2.2° and settles in 10f
The background light pool and dust shift down 150px against the tilt so it reads as the camera tilting up, with vertical motion blur on the fastest frames
Something happens after landing: the chart line draws with a glowing pen tip (38–82f), the end dot pops at 80f, and a 1.8% push-in keeps the hold alive; length 145f to 120f
